ISD lists 14 schools in Limassol. iCan School (ages 6–12, EUR 14,100), Lighthouse (ages 4–14, EUR 10,400) and Golden Oak (ages 3–12, EUR 7,700) are suitable only for the 11-year-old child, so they are not included in the table. École Franco-Chypriote operates in French. Heritage Private School, Silverline and IMS do not publish prices in ISD. In Cyprus the difference between tiers is small: even the best schools cost EUR 11–16 thousand a year. Native British teachers are also found in tier 2, because schools recruit in the UK. The main risk is overcrowding of schools after many families moved to Limassol after 2022; Heritage and Foley's sometimes have waiting lists.
